deploy-bot: Deployment finished for canary group C at 2712349876. Post-deploy smoke started: synthetic heartbeat probes running.
maya: seeing ~1.8% transient 503s from eu4 kv-synth around t+30s. nothing huge but above baseline.
aj: can you post the raw probe logs? which probe? kv vs prefix?
maya: kv probe, probe id kv-heartbeat-7. sample: `2026-03-15T12:17:07Z eu4 kv-heartbeat-7 503 instance=i-07f..` repeated across 4 hosts
lucas: rolling window for this deploy is 15m, threshold for auto-continue is 1%. we're above it — deploybot should have paused but looks like it continued. @deploy-bot what was the policy applied?
deploy-bot: policy=rolling-15m; auto-continue=false when probe_error_rate > 1.0%. Deterministic decision: attempted 3 fast retries and then continued due to stale quorum signal. decision log: `quorum_check:stale=true`
olivia: stale quorum suggests telemetry lag. can we run a targeted synthetic sweep on eu4 now? `smokectl run --region eu4 --probe kv-heartbeat-7 --samples 200`
aj: running that now, attaching results when done
oncall-bot: Alert created: INC-2026-0315-44 - elevated kv-synth errors in eu4. Pager duty notified.
maya: results from smokectl: 200 samples -> 3.5% 503, 96% 200, p95 latency 85ms. distribution shows spikes on two hosts: i-07f.. and i-0a3..
lucas: suggest temporarily pinning canary to previous runtime variant on eu4 only and re-run warmup. We should also add a quick release note about the region hold for ops.
aj: +1. Action: rollback-model-variant eu4 -> runtime-v1.9.2, leave other regions rolling. I can kick that in 2 minutes and warmup caches.
olivia: I'll update the change window notes and push a short entry to the release channel: "eu4 hold: canary pinned to v1.9.2 pending host-level investigation". Also adding a postmortem checklist item: capture host gc logs and nvml stats.
maya: thanks — while aj does the pin, can someone add a temporary synthetic throttle to reduce probe fanout? we might be amplifying a noisy host.
aj: executing pin: `deployctl pin-variant --region eu4 --variant runtime-v1.9.2 --reason "postdeploy kv-synth spike"` -> done at 2712349892
aj: warming caches: `smokectl warmup --region eu4 --keyspace kv --parallel 8` -> started
olivia: release note posted to #announcements briefly and linked in change window doc (link: https://intranet/release/2026-03-15/2712349876)
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-44 updated: status=investigating, assignees=maya,aj
maya: monitoring heatmap now showing rate back to 0.9% after pin + warmup. will monitor for 10m then decide whether to resume rollout.
lucas: good call. after 10m, if sustained <1%, we can resume canary in eu4 with a slower stagger. record decision in release notes.
aj: note for followup: collect `dmesg`, `nvml-smi` snapshots from the two hosts and check kernel driver versions. opening a ticket.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy paused for eu4 at 2712349893 per policy. Canary continues in other regions. Logs and decision recorded.
